evals.expected_output: Reports one actionable finding on the changed guard because a missing user now falls through and dereferences null.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Reports exactly one P1 or P2 finding.
Cites the changed guard line.
Explains the missing-user scenario without speculative claims.

evals.expected_output: Reports no finding because the change safely handles the missing-user case.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Returns No findings.
Does not invent a style or return-type complaint without repository evidence.

evals.expected_output: Does not report the unchanged parser behavior as a change-introduced defect.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Returns No findings unless repository context demonstrates a defect introduced by the comment.
Does not cite unchanged code as the cause of a finding.

evals.prompt:
Review this diff:
```diff
-const result=compute(value)
+const result = compute(value);
```
evals.expected_output: Returns no finding unless the repository's configured tooling proves the change breaks a required convention.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Does not report a preference-only finding.
Does not run broad validation without a candidate defect.

evals.prompt: Review a change that intentionally makes retry count zero disable retries. The implementation, public docs, and regression test all agree on the new behavior.
evals.expected_output: Does not report the documented behavior change merely because it differs from the prior implementation.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Checks the implementation and test before judging intent.
Does not treat an intentional tested change as a regression.

evals.prompt: Review this branch against main. The local main ref is behind origin/main, and the branch has an upstream.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the appropriate comparison ref, computes the merge base, and reviews the changes that would actually merge.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Uses the upstream comparison ref when it is ahead and available.
Does not diff HEAD directly against the branch tip.
Keeps the workflow read-only.

evals.expected_output: When the working tree is clean, reports that no uncommitted review target exists instead of silently reviewing the last commit.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Does not fall back to the last commit.
Does not modify the working tree.

evals.prompt: AGENTS.md says rawResponseItem event names must remain backward compatible. Review a diff that changes only an unrelated internal variable name.
evals.expected_output: Applies the repository rule only to its governed integration surface and reports no compatibility finding for the unrelated rename.
assertions: Activates code-reviewer.
Reads the applicable AGENTS.md rule.
Returns No findings for the unrelated safe change.
Does not broaden a scoped invariant into a generic naming rule.
